meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Investor management and fund administration software for private equity and real estate general partners

analysis.summary: Rivals are racing to open their data to AI tools, and Agora is attacking competitors by name. Juniper Square leads on product pages but has no comparison or switching content.

points.text: Agora published 4 comparison pages, including InvestNext and Cash Flow Portal alternatives. Juniper Square has none in this data.
Three rivals now push AI-connection pages: Juniper Square's Headless GPX, InvestNext's MCP pages and Agora's API and MCP access.
Agora updated 44 old pages and published 20 how-to guides, mostly real estate. That is a broad push to win early-stage searchers.

Juniper Square.play: Launch AI products (Capital Intelligence, JunieAI, Headless GPX) and refresh 27 product pages across PE, VC and real estate.
Juniper Square.aimed: PE, VC and real estate GPs

Allvue Systems.play: Almost silent: one product page and one event recap. Too little to call a strategy.

SS&C GlobalOps.play: Publishes opinion and explainers on 1031 exchanges, private credit and K-1 work. Few product pages.

InvestNext.play: Pushes AI and MCP (a way for AI tools to use your data) across refreshed feature pages.
InvestNext.aimed: Smaller real estate and PE sponsors

Agora.play: Wins real estate searches with guides, comparison pages and fresh product pages. Adds API and MCP access.
Agora.aimed: Real estate GPs, early and late stage

shared.title: Open data for AI tools
shared.text: Juniper Square (Headless GPX, APIs), InvestNext (MCP pages) and Agora (API and MCP) all say their data works with outside AI. Expect buyers to ask about it.

shared.title: Big refresh of product pages
shared.text: Agora updated 44 old pages, Juniper Square 27 and InvestNext 16. This is a refresh push to match new AI messaging, not a wave of new pages.

shared.title: AI as a learning topic
shared.text: InvestNext has AI workflow guides. Agora has AI guides for real estate and fund accounting. Both use AI to attract researchers, not just buyers.

gaps.title: Switching playbook
gaps.text: No one publishes a step-by-step guide to changing fund admin or portal providers: timeline, data move, investor communication. Juniper Square can own the switcher's search.

gaps.title: Juniper Square versus pages
gaps.text: Agora names InvestNext and Cash Flow Portal in alternatives pages. Juniper Square has no head-to-head pages in this data. It could frame its own comparisons first.

gaps.title: Switcher customer stories
gaps.text: Juniper Square has 3 case studies. Rivals have almost none that are relevant: Agora's one is internal, SS&C's is off-topic. Stories of GPs who switched are open.

versus.Allvue Systems: Allvue published 2 pages and updated none. Juniper Square publishes and refreshes far more product content aimed at buyers.
versus.SS&C GlobalOps: SS&C writes broad thought leadership for researchers. Juniper Square writes product pages for buyers, with little opinion content (1 piece).
versus.InvestNext: InvestNext mirrors Juniper Square's AI and open-access push, and adds one comparison page and AI how-to guides that Juniper Square lacks.
versus.Agora: Agora outpaces Juniper Square on guides (20), comparison pages (4) and refreshes (44), but is focused mainly on real estate.
